goal: Deliver in-Lane literal-user decision detection via laneDecisionFacts, slot parking, structured GitHub question publication bound to (run_id, record_revision), and verified owner reply relay via relayLaneDecision under S6 (D7, BR-SCN-4) of docs/specs/loop-daemon.spec.md.

acceptance.assertion: Source BR-REQ-5, BR-SCN-4; meet S6 and D7 in docs/specs/loop-daemon.spec.md: when a supervised Lane pauses on a user_only decision in laneDecisionFacts, decision_relay.ts parks the active concurrency slot, posts a structured GitHub Issue comment carrying run_id and record_revision, verifies the replying owner login/association and matching (run_id, record_revision), and relays the decision via relayLaneDecision while rejecting non-owner or stale-revision replies.
